official_demand.scope: United States, Google Web Search, past 12 months, search terms; combined comparison. Browser chart and weekly table reviewed.
official_demand.units: normalized 0–100; no official absolute monthly volume

competition_sample.source: Existing OpenSEO research on branch codex/ai-opencode-search-guides (c787517); recorded URLs and estimates reused.

baseline.scope: Site-level daily rows, before release; not a new URL baseline.

acceptance: Check indexing and URL-level US Web impressions, clicks, CTR and position in complete comparable windows after indexing. Inspect actual queries where disclosed; do not infer rank or clicks from publication.

publication_review.task: Identify the Go usage limit reached and compute usage across multiple models.
publication_review.answer_gap: Official Console shows account use and model terms; the sampled review describes pricing and earlier limits. The sampled answers do not offer the same editable, same-window calculation using per-model inputs.
publication_review.unique_value: A browser-only, multi-model calculator paired with a worked example, reset/credit checks, and a no-JavaScript answer.

publication_review.task: Install and diagnose a local skill that is missing, ignored or resolving to the wrong file.
publication_review.answer_gap: The sampled SkillMap post covers management and duplicate governance; the sampled desktop discussion addresses usage. They do not document the same controlled versioned CLI comparisons.
publication_review.unique_value: Four controlled V1 discovery fixtures including the unexpectedly listed skill without a description, with version boundaries and live troubleshooting steps.
